resilience.note: Armoured Carapace: AR 4, PHASE SHIFTER: AR 2*

bonuses.name: Architect of Ruin
bonuses.text: The GM gains 1 point of Ruin at the start of each of this Threat’s turns.

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 3 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Living Metal
bonuses.text: At the start of each of this Threat’s turns it regains 1 Wound and 1 Shock.

bonuses.name: My Will Be Done
bonuses.text: Individuals and Mobs that share a [DYNASTY] Keyword with the Overlord and can see the Overlord gain +2 bonus dice to all Tests.

abilities.name: Resurrection Orb
abilities.text: Roll 10d6. The Resurrection Orb restores a number of Wounds equal to the number of Icons rolled to any individual or Mob within 10 m of the Necron Lord that share a [DYNASTY] Keyword, including destroyed Necrons. The Resurrection Orb can only be used once per day.

abilities.name: Reanimation Protocols
abilities.text: When this Threat is destroyed, roll a d6. If the result is an Exalted Icon, it is resurrected with 1 Wound and 1 Shock.
